nodes.name: Draft Webhook
nodes.notes: FR1: the project's one deliberate externally-reachable surface. responseMode='responseNode' (NOT gmail-ingestion.json's 'onReceived') -- each of the six possible outcomes (200/401/404/429 cooldown/429 regen cap/502) sends its own distinct status + body via its own 'Respond ...' node at the matching terminal branch, instead of a single immediate ack. No fixed input schema is declared here since webhooks receive raw body/headers; downstream nodes read $json.headers / $json.body explicitly.

nodes.name: Blocked?
nodes.notes: True (index 0) -> Respond 429 - cooldown, stop. False (index 1) -> Verify secret. Matches gmail-ingestion.json's 'Token valid?' true/false output convention.

nodes.name: Respond 429 - cooldown

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "too many failed attempts, try again later" } }}

nodes.notes: Terminal. FR3's global cooldown rejection -- fired regardless of whether this particular request's secret would have been correct.

nodes.name: Verify secret
nodes.notes: Env-var custody decision documented in this node's jsCode comment (see above) -- resolves proposal.md's shared-secret custody Open Question in favor of $env.DRAFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET over an n8n credential. Extended by 010-dashboard-actions-drafts-api (spec FR8) to also read and default `tone`/`length` off the request body -- carried forward to `Build draft prompt` by node-name reference, same convention as `email_id`.

nodes.name: Auth ok?
nodes.notes: True (index 0, authFailed) -> Respond 401, stop. False (index 1) -> Check email exists.

nodes.name: Respond 401
nodes.notes: Terminal. FR2's rejection for a missing/wrong secret -- reached before any data read, cap check, or LLM Gateway call (AC2).

nodes.name: Check email exists

parameters.query: SELECT id, thread_id FROM emails WHERE id = $1;

nodes.notes: FR5. alwaysOutputData=true mirrors the write-node pattern in action-extraction.json ('Write extraction error'): forces exactly one pass-through item even when zero rows match, so 'Email exists?' always runs and the 404 branch is always reachable rather than the workflow silently stopping with no response.

nodes.name: Found?
nodes.notes: True (index 0) -> Check regeneration cap. False (index 1, not found) -> Respond 404, stop (FR5).

nodes.name: Respond 404
nodes.notes: Terminal. FR5 -- the requested email_id does not exist in emails.

nodes.name: Check regeneration cap

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drafts WHERE email_id = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';

nodes.notes: FR4, checked before any LLM Gateway call. COUNT(*) always returns exactly one row, so no alwaysOutputData needed here.

nodes.name: Cap reached?
nodes.notes: True (index 0) -> Respond 429 - regeneration limit, stop (FR4/AC5). False (index 1) -> Read thread.

nodes.name: Respond 429 - regeneration limit
nodes.notes: Terminal. FR4/AC5 -- 5 or more drafts already written for this email_id in the last hour; no LLM Gateway call is made.

nodes.name: Read thread

parameters.query: SELECT id, participants, subject, body, received_at FROM emails WHERE thread_id = (SELECT thread_id FROM emails WHERE id = $1) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 10;

nodes.notes: FR6: explicit column list (never SELECT *, never raw_payload), bounded to the 10 most recent messages by received_at. Always returns >= 1 row since 'Found?' already confirmed the named email_id exists (it is necessarily a member of its own thread). Feeds 'Build draft prompt' by node-name reference ($('Read thread').all()), not via direct item pass-through, so the sequential 'Read style sample' node downstream can run without losing this data.

nodes.name: Read style sample

parameters.query: SELECT id, subject, body FROM emails WHERE labels @> '["SENT"]' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 5;

nodes.notes: FR7, best-effort, no parameters (queries all SENT-labelled mail in the account, not scoped to this email's thread). executeOnce=true is required here: this node receives 'Read thread's N output rows as its input items, and without executeOnce a parameterless Postgres node still runs once per input item -- duplicating the style sample N times. alwaysOutputData=true because zero rows is an expected, valid result (AC6/FR7) -- it must not fail the request, and 'Build draft prompt' below filters out the resulting empty pass-through item.

nodes.name: Build draft prompt
nodes.notes: FR6/FR7/FR8. Truncates every body to 1500 chars and wraps each quoted email (thread and style sample alike) in <<<EMAIL_START>>>/<<<EMAIL_END>>> delimiters before it ever reaches user_content. Carries email_id through for 'Validate result' to read via .first(). Extended by 010-dashboard-actions-drafts-api (spec FR8): system_prompt now includes a tone/length instruction, additive to the existing style-sample and prompt-injection-defense wording, neither of which is touched. Extended again by 0012_drafts_custom_instruction: tone 'custom' swaps the fixed tone adjective for a pointer at a new, distinctly-delimited <<<USER_INSTRUCTION_START/END>>> block in user_content (never the same markers as untrusted email content), and the systemPrompt clause explicitly bounds that block's authority to the standing rules -- it can steer the reply, not override reply-only/no-invented-facts/JSON-only.

nodes.name: Call LLM Gateway
nodes.notes:
FR9. References the 'LLM Gateway' sub-workflow BY NAME (cachedResultName), same placeholder pattern as Triage Pipeline's / Action Extraction's 'Call LLM Gateway' -- workflowId.value is left blank since no live n8n instance/workflow ID exists yet. Re-point at the real workflow via the resource picker once llm-gateway.json is imported. Passes { system_prompt, user_content, response_schema } per LLM Gateway's generic contract, unmodified from llm-gateway.json.

MANUAL POST-IMPORT STEP -- 30s timeout (FR9/design.md) NOT set in this JSON: I could not confirm a real, importable JSON key for a per-node execution timeout on n8n-nodes-base.executeWorkflow at typeVersion 1.2 (there is no documented 'timeout' field under this node type's parameters, and guessing a nonexistent parameter key risks a silently-ignored or import-breaking field). Do NOT invent one. Instead, after importing this workflow, open this node in the n8n editor and set the timeout in the node's Settings tab (or wrap this call with an equivalent workflow-level safeguard) to 30000 ms manually. Flagged explicitly for the T4 runbook to call out as a required manual step.

nodes.name: Validate result
nodes.notes: FR10. success:false, a timeout (surfaces as success:false from LLM Gateway's own try/catch contract), or a missing/empty/non-string draft_body are all treated as a generation failure -- never written as an empty or partial draft.

nodes.name: Outcome?
nodes.notes: Same shape as action-extraction.json's 'Outcome?' switch, with two routes here instead of three: success -> Write draft -> Respond 200; error -> Write generation error -> Respond 502.

nodes.name: Write draft

parameters.query: INSERT INTO drafts (email_id, draft_body, generated_body, status, tone, length, custom_instruction) VALUES ($1, $2, $2, 'pending', $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, email_id, draft_body, generated_body, status, tone, length, custom_instruction, created_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.email_id, $json.draft_body, $('Build draft prompt').first().json.tone, $('Build draft prompt').first().json.length, $('Build draft prompt').first().json.custom_instruction] }}

nodes.notes: 010-dashboard-actions-drafts-api spec FR9: generated_body is set to the same value as draft_body at insert time ($2 reused for both columns) -- the immutable original, before any edit. tone/length/custom_instruction are read back from 'Build draft prompt' by node-name reference (Validate result's output doesn't carry them). RETURNING is extended so 'Respond 200' echoes the new columns too. FR12/AC1. No ON CONFLICT -- drafts.email_id deliberately carries no uniqueness constraint (design.md Key Decisions), multiple drafts per email is intended, bounded by FR4's regeneration cap instead. Reuses the same 'Supabase Postgres' credential (same name + placeholder id) every prior phase's write nodes use (NFR3) -- do not create a new credential. RETURNING gives 'Respond 200' the full row to echo back as-is. Extended by 0012_drafts_custom_instruction: custom_instruction column added ($5); requires that migration deployed first, or every insert violates the drafts_tone_check constraint the moment tone='custom' reaches this query.

nodes.name: Respond 200
nodes.notes: Terminal. AC1 -- responds with the full inserted drafts row ({ id, email_id, draft_body, status, created_at }) exactly as 'Write draft' RETURNING produced it.

nodes.name: Write generation error

parameters.query: UPDATE emails SET draft_generation_error = $1 WHERE id = $2;

nodes.notes: FR11/AC7. No drafts row is written on this path. Same reused 'Supabase Postgres' credential as 'Write draft' (NFR3).

nodes.name: Respond 502
nodes.notes: Terminal. FR11/AC7 -- generation failure (LLM Gateway success:false, timeout, or malformed draft_body).

parameters.content:
## Draft Generation

External POST /webhook/generate-draft (header x-draft-webhook-secret, body { email_id }) -> cooldown check -> constant-time secret verification (may trip the cooldown) -> email-exists check -> regeneration cap -> thread read + best-effort sent-mail style sample -> delimited prompt build -> LLM Gateway (unmodified) -> validate -> guarded drafts insert or emails.draft_generation_error write -> one of six terminal HTTP responses (200/401/404/429 cooldown/429 regeneration limit/502).

Not invoked from Email Normaliser -- reached directly over HTTP, on demand. No Gmail credential anywhere in this workflow (FR13/NFR2): the absence of any capability to auto-send is structural, not a convention.

See .specclaw/changes/006-draft-generation/spec.md (FR1-FR13, AC1-AC8) and design.md (Architecture, Key Decisions).

### Placeholders / manual steps to fill in on import

- **Supabase Postgres** credential (name 'Supabase Postgres', placeholder id REPLACE_WITH_SUPABASE_POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID) -- reuse the same credential every prior phase's write nodes already hold (NFR3), do not create a new one.
- **DRAFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET** -- set this as an n8n environment variable (NOT an n8n credential; see 'Verify secret' node's notes for why) before activating this workflow. Generate it CSPRNG, >= 32 bytes, per NFR4/Risks; document rotation in the runbook (T4).
- 'Call LLM Gateway' targets the 'LLM Gateway' sub-workflow by name only (workflowId.value is blank) -- re-point it at the real workflow via the resource picker once llm-gateway.json is imported.
- MANUAL: 'Call LLM Gateway' has no importable 30s-timeout JSON key (see that node's notes) -- set a 30000ms timeout on that node's Settings tab by hand after import. Call this out explicitly in the T4 runbook.
- No pinData is included here by design (NFR1) -- pin mock data directly on 'Call LLM Gateway's output in the n8n editor when testing AC1/AC4/AC6/AC7.
- Migration 0004 (drafts table + emails.draft_generation_error) must be applied before this workflow's write nodes are enabled.
